intro: Button is HeroUI’s button with one props API on web and native: seven variants, three sizes, a disabled and a loading state, icons on either side and a full-width form. The look is HeroUI’s, themed by the stackra tokens.

variants.title: Variants and sizes
variants.note: One row per size, one button per variant, each labelled with its variant name.

states.title: States
states.note: Each variant default, disabled and loading. A loading button refuses presses and keeps focus.

icons.title: Icons
icons.note: An icon on the inline-start side, the inline-end side or both. The chevron is mirrored in right-to-left: switch to Arabic.

full_width.title: Full width
full_width.note: The button stretches to its container, here a narrow column.

live.title: Try it
live.note: Press Save: it loads for a moment and keeps focus. The counter button counts presses; the disabled one does not.
